content.text: {"id": "mm6936a3", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "CDC analyzed data from the 2017 and 2018 Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System (BRFSS) surveys"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "This report presents unadjusted prevalences and adjusted prevalence ratios (aPRs) for selected underlying conditions."}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Obesity and hypertension were the most common conditions in every essential worker group."}, {"loc": "table 2", "q": "Unadjusted, weighted estimates."}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Obesity and hypertension were the most common conditions in every essential worker group."}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "to compare the prevalence of each condition in the occupation (or industry) of interest to its prevalence among workers from all other"}]}, {"v": "stratified/adjusted", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Adjustments were made for age group (18–29, 30–39, 40–49, 50–59, 60–69, ≥70 years), sex (male, female)"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "cross-sectional", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "BRFSS is an annual, state-based, random-digit–dialed landline and cellular telephone survey"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Logistic regression in SUDAAN (version 11.0.1; RTI International) was used to calculate aPRs to compare the prevalence of each condition"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Adjustments were made for age group (18–29, 30–39, 40–49, 50–59, 60–69, ≥70 years), sex (male, female)"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "aPRs with confidence intervals not spanning the null value were considered statistically significant."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "For each occupation or industry, demographic distributions and unadjusted prevalences for each chronic condition were calculated using the SURVEYFREQ procedure in SAS"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Data were weighted and analyzed in accordance with the survey’s complex sampling design."}, {"loc": "note", "q": "Minimum sample size for each occupation or industry was 1,000 in the analytic data set"}], "confidence": "high", "uncertain_fields": []}
